mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS sku_id, s.spu_id, p.name AS spu_name, s.name, s.price, s.stock, s.status, spec.name AS spec_name, sv.value AS spec_value FROM product_sku s LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON s.spu_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku_spec ss ON s.id = ss.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spec spec ON ss.spec_id = spec.id LEFT JOIN product_spec_value sv ON ss.spec_value_id = sv.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
